book: English Grammar in Use · Raymond Murphy · Cambridge

units.title: Present Perfect 1
units.grammar: Результат в настоящем или опыт. have/has + V3. I have finished. She has been to Paris.

units.title: Present Perfect 2 (just / already / yet)
units.grammar: Just = только что. Already = уже. Yet = ещё (в вопросах и отрицаниях).

units.title: Present Perfect Continuous
units.grammar: Действие началось в прошлом и продолжается. have/has been + V-ing. I have been working since morning.

exercises.q: How long ___ you been living here?

units.title: Present Perfect Continuous vs Present Perfect Simple
units.grammar: Continuous — акцент на длительности. Simple — акцент на результате. I've been reading (процесс) vs I've read (результат).

exercises.q: My eyes are tired. I ___ all day.
She ___ her homework. She can go out.

units.title: How long have you (been)?
units.grammar: Вопрос о длительности действия. How long have you been + V-ing? / How long have you + V3?

exercises.q: How long ___ you been learning English?

units.title: For and Since
units.grammar: For + период (for 5 years). Since + момент (since 2020, since Monday).

units.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple 1
units.grammar: Past Simple — конкретное время в прошлом (yesterday, last week). Present Perfect — без конкретного времени, результат важен.

units.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple 2
units.grammar: Продолжение сравнения. Today, this week — Present Perfect. Yesterday, in 2020 — Past Simple.

exercises.q: I ___ three cups of coffee today.
I ___ three cups of coffee yesterday.
She ___ in London for 5 years (и продолжает).
He ___ in London for 5 years (и уехал).

units.title: Past Perfect
units.grammar: Действие до другого действия в прошлом. had + V3. When I arrived, she had already left.

exercises.q: When I arrived, she ___ already left.
I ___ never seen such a beautiful sunset before that evening.
By the time we got there, they ___ .
She told me she ___ the film.

units.title: Past Perfect Continuous
units.grammar: Действие продолжалось до определённого момента в прошлом. had been + V-ing. She had been waiting for 2 hours.

exercises.q: She ___ been waiting for 2 hours when he came.
They ___ been driving all day before they stopped.
I was tired because I ___ been working hard.
How long ___ you been learning before the exam?

units.title: Used to (do)
units.grammar: Привычка в прошлом, которой больше нет. I used to smoke. She used to live in Paris.

exercises.q: I ___ to smoke, but I quit.
Did you ___ to play the piano?

units.title: Настоящее время для будущего
units.grammar: Present Simple/Continuous могут выражать будущее: The train leaves at 6. I'm meeting her tomorrow.

exercises.q: We ___ dinner with them on Sunday.

units.title: I will vs I'm going to
units.grammar: Will — решение сейчас. Going to — план заранее. The phone is ringing! — I'll answer it. I'm going to visit my mum on Sunday.

exercises.q: I've decided. I ___ buy a new car.
The phone is ringing! — I ___ get it.
We ___ visit Paris next summer (уже решили).

units.title: Future Continuous / Future Perfect
units.grammar: Future Continuous: will be + V-ing (в процессе). Future Perfect: will have + V3 (завершено к моменту).

exercises.q: By next year she ___ finished the course.
This time tomorrow I ___ flying to Rome.

units.title: When / If
units.grammar: После when и if будущее время НЕ используется. When I arrive, I will call you (НЕ will arrive).

exercises.q: When I ___ home, I will call you.
If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay home.
I'll tell her when she ___ back.
If you ___ hard, you will pass.

units.title: Can / Could / (be) able to
units.grammar: Can — способность сейчас. Could — способность в прошлом / вежливая просьба. Be able to — все времена.

exercises.q: When I was young, I ___ run fast.

units.title: Could do vs could have done
units.grammar: Could — сейчас/в будущем. Could have done — не сделал в прошлом. I could have helped you (но не помог).

exercises.q: We ___ gone to the beach, but it rained.
I ___ do it now if you want.

units.title: Must и can't (дедукция)
units.grammar: Must — уверенная догадка (должно быть). Can't — невозможно. She must be tired. He can't be at home (света нет).

exercises.q: The lights are on. Someone ___ be at home.
He ___ be hungry — he just ate.
She's been working all day. She ___ be tired.
You've just had lunch. You ___ be hungry.

units.title: May / Might 1
units.grammar: Возможность (может быть). I may go to the party. She might be late.

exercises.q: I ___ go to the party tomorrow.
She ___ be late — traffic is bad.
They ___ come or they may not — we don't know yet.
He ___ be at the office, but I'm not sure.

units.title: May / Might 2
units.grammar: May / might для разрешения (вежливо). May I come in? Also: might в третьем типе conditional.

exercises.q: If I had studied, I ___ have passed.
She ___ have missed the train — I'm not sure.

units.title: Have to vs Must
units.grammar: Have to — внешняя обязанность (правила, закон). Must — личное решение/убеждение. I have to wear a uniform (правило). I must call my mum (сам решил).

exercises.q: I ___ wear a uniform at work. It's the rule.
I ___ call my mother. I promised.
We ___ hurry — we have plenty of time.

units.title: Must / Mustn't / Needn't
units.grammar: Must — должен. Mustn't — запрещено. Needn't — не обязательно (нет необходимости).

exercises.q: You ___ come if you don't want to.
I ___ finish it today, tomorrow is fine.

units.title: Should (Ought to)
units.grammar: Совет, рекомендация. You should see a doctor. Ought to — более формальный вариант.

exercises.q: You ___ smoke — it's bad for you.

units.title: Should (продолжение)
units.grammar: Should для ожиданий (должно быть так, но не факт). She should be home by now.

exercises.q: They ___ be here by now, usually they're on time.
You shouldn't ___ so much money on shoes.
I think you should ___ him the truth.

units.title: Would
units.grammar: Would — вежливая просьба, гипотетическая ситуация, привычка в прошлом. I would like... Would you...?

exercises.q: I ___ like a cup of tea, please.
When I was a child, I ___ play in the park every day.
What ___ you do if you won the lottery?

units.title: First Conditional
units.grammar: Реальные условия в будущем. If + Present Simple, will + V. If it rains, I will stay home.

exercises.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
I will help you if you ___ me.
If you don't hurry, you ___ the train.

units.title: Second Conditional
units.grammar: Нереальные условия в настоящем. If + Past Simple, would + V. If I were rich, I would travel the world.

exercises.q: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
If I ___ you, I would apologise.
She ___ help you if she had time.
What would you do if you ___ a million dollars?

units.title: Passive Voice 1
units.grammar: Страдательный залог: be + V3. Акцент на действии. This house was built in 1900.

units.title: Passive Voice 2 (времена)
units.grammar: Пассив во всех временах. Present: is done. Past: was done. Present Perfect: has been done. Future: will be done.

units.title: Passive Voice 3 (by / with)
units.grammar: Действующее лицо через by. Инструмент — через with. Hamlet was written by Shakespeare.

exercises.q: The letter was written ___ a pen.
The window was broken ___ a child.
The soup was made ___ fresh vegetables.

units.title: Reported Speech 1
units.grammar: Косвенная речь. Сдвиг времён на шаг назад: present → past, will → would. He said he was tired.

units.title: Question Tags
units.grammar: Разделительные вопросы. You are tired, aren't you? She doesn't smoke, does she?

units.title: Глагол + -ing (Gerund)
units.grammar: После некоторых глаголов — только -ing: enjoy, mind, suggest, avoid, finish, keep, practise, recommend.

units.title: Глагол + to (Infinitive)
units.grammar: После некоторых глаголов — только to + V: decide, hope, plan, want, need, offer, promise, refuse, learn, forget.

units.title: Like / Love / Hate
units.grammar: Like doing — вообще нравится. Like to do — считаю правильным. Смысл меняется.

exercises.q: I like ___ books in the evening.
I like ___ my teeth twice a day.

units.title: Предлог + -ing
units.grammar: После предлогов всегда -ing. I'm interested in learning. She's good at cooking.

units.title: Инфинитив цели (to / in order to)
units.grammar: Чтобы — to / in order to / so as to + V. I came here to study.

exercises.q: She left early ___ catch the train.
I'm saving money ___ buy a car.
He works hard ___ support his family.

units.title: Инфинитив после прилагательных
units.grammar: Прилагательное + to + V: I'm happy to help. It's nice to meet you. She's easy to talk to.

units.title: The (уникальные объекты)
units.grammar: The с уникальными: the sun, the moon, the sky, the Earth, the government, the police.

units.title: The (children / the children)
units.grammar: The + существительное = все/конкретная группа. Children like sweets (все). The children in my class are nice.

exercises.q: ___ children in my class are very smart.
___ life of a doctor is hard.

units.title: Множественное число (особые случаи)
units.grammar: Неправильные: man→men, woman→women, child→children, foot→feet, tooth→teeth, mouse→mice.

exercises.q: There are three ___ in the room.

units.title: Притяжательный падеж -'s и of
units.grammar: 's — для людей и животных (John's car). of — для вещей (the color of the sky).

exercises.q: The color ___ the sky is blue.

units.title: Возвратные местоимения
units.grammar: Myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves. I hurt myself. She made it herself.

units.title: No / None / Any
units.grammar: No = not any. None — ни один (из группы). None of them came. There are no apples.

exercises.q: There are ___ apples in the fridge.
___ of my friends came to the party.

units.title: Much / Many / Little / Few
units.grammar: Much + неисчисляемое. Many + исчисляемое. Little / a little + неисчисляемое. Few / a few + исчисляемое.

exercises.q: I have ___ time — I'm very busy.
Only ___ people came to the meeting.

units.title: Most / Most of / All of
units.grammar: Most + сущ. (без the) = большинство. Most of + the/my/them = большинство из. All of us = все мы.

units.title: Either / Neither / Both
units.grammar: Both — оба. Either — любой из двух. Neither — ни один из двух. Both of us / Either of them / Neither of them.

exercises.q: ___ of them came — they were both busy.

units.title: Relative Clauses (who / that / which)
units.grammar: Who — для людей. Which — для вещей. That — и для того и для другого (в defining clauses).

exercises.q: The man ___ called you is my uncle.
The book ___ I bought is good.
The girl ___ is singing is my sister.
This is the car ___ I want to buy.

units.title: Прилагательные на -ing и -ed
units.grammar: -ing — вызывает чувство. -ed — испытывает чувство. Boring (скучный) vs bored (скучающий).

units.title: Суффикс -ly
units.grammar: Наречия образуются от прилагательных + ly: quick → quickly. Но есть исключения: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard.

units.title: So и Such
units.grammar: So + прилагательное / наречие. Such + существительное. So beautiful. Such a beautiful day.

units.title: Too и Enough
units.grammar: Too + adj (слишком). Enough — достаточно. Too hot. Not hot enough. Enough после прилагательного.

exercises.q: He isn't tall ___ to reach it.

units.title: Сравнительная степень 2
units.grammar: Особые случаи: good → better, bad → worse, far → further, little → less, many/much → more.

exercises.q: My house is ___ from here than yours.

units.title: Наречия с глаголом
units.grammar: Наречия частоты (always, usually, never) — перед смысловым глаголом, но после be. I always go. I am always late.

units.title: Still / Yet / Already
units.grammar: Still — всё ещё (продолжается). Yet — уже (в вопросах/отрицаниях). Already — уже (в утверждениях).

units.title: Although / Though / Despite
units.grammar: Although/though + предложение. Despite/in spite of + сущ./-ing. Despite the rain, we went out.

exercises.q: ___ it was raining, we went out.

units.title: As (в то время как)
units.grammar: As = when / while. As I was leaving, the phone rang. As = так как. As you know...

exercises.q: ___ I was leaving, the phone rang.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: введение
units.grammar: Глагол + предлог/наречие = новое значение. Give up (бросить), look after (заботиться), put off (отложить).

units.title: On time vs In time
units.grammar: On time — точно по расписанию. In time — заранее, с запасом. The train arrived on time. We got there in time for the film.

exercises.q: We got there just ___ time to see the start.
I hope we arrive ___ time to catch the plane.

units.title: Глагол + предлог 1
units.grammar: Устойчивые: listen to, look at, wait for, ask for, belong to, depend on, laugh at, look for.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: In и Out
units.grammar: In — внутрь/включение. Out — наружу/исключение. Come in. Go out. Fill in. Find out.

exercises.q: I need to find ___ what happened.

units.title: Фразовые глаголы: On и Off 1
units.grammar: On — включение/продолжение. Off — выключение/отмена. Turn on/off. Switch on/off. Put on. Take off.

exercises.q: Turn ___ the light before you leave.
I need to take ___ my shoes.
